Initial release of Hindi Video Editing With AI.

- Edit raw Hindi video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) with AI-generated captions, cuts, and effects.
- Seamless upload, edit, and export workflow—get 1080p MP4 results in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Automatic token handling: supports registered users and anonymous users with free trial credits.
- Supports key editing actions: adding Hindi subtitles, trimming silences, overlaying music, aspect ratio changes, and more.
- Real-time session management, status updates, and clear feedback on errors and progress.
- Designed for Hindi content creators needing fast, AI-powered video editing.
